summary: Salmones Camanchaca, BioMar, and Skretting have signed an unprecedented agreement focused on sustainability in salmon farming. The collaboration signals industry alignment on environmental and operational standards for aquaculture feed and production practices.
title: Salmones Camanchaca, BioMar y Skretting firman inédito acuerdo para sostenibilidad
